Four Nihangs Granted Bail in Uttarakhand Incident; More Sikhs Gather in Himachal

Four Nihang Sikhs arrested in connection with a June 16 incident in Karnaprayag, Uttarakhand, have been granted bail by the Gopeshwar District Court. Following this development, over 150 Nihang Sikhs have reportedly gathered at a Gurudwara in Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh, to offer prayers and seek the release of their arrested companions.
